name: FPLGuru
description: An AI-powered Fantasy Premier League assistant. React frontend on AWS S3, Python backend on Railway, RAG pipeline that re-embeds player data each gameweek using GPT-4o and Pinecone. Currently exploring fine-tuning Gemma-class models for FPL-specific strategy (chip timing, wildcards) beyond what stat-based retrieval handles well.

name: Raindrop.io MCP Server
description: An MCP server that exposes Raindrop.io bookmark management to LLM agents over HTTP/SSE. Built and presented at internal community events; now part of my personal and team workflows for AI-assisted knowledge management. Deployed to Railway with GitHub Actions CI/CD.

name: Notificity
description: An Android app that captures and categorises every incoming push notification, with search by app or keyword. Built originally as a debugging tool during SDK development at CleverTap, then open-sourced as an architecture reference for the Android community. MVVM, Kotlin Coroutines and Flows, Jetpack Compose, Hilt, Robolectric, JUnit, Mockk. Six external contributors and counting.

name: RainSurfer
description: A web app that helps you rediscover articles you saved on Raindrop.io. Pick a collection, see a random article preview, then read it, mark it done, or skip to the next. OAuth 2.0 against the Raindrop API.
